sql:
select c.id, c.started_at, c.errors, c.programs_listed, c.new_terms, c.changed_terms, c.disappeared,
 c.notes_json->>'ended_paid_out_unstamped' as unstamped,
 (select count(*) from incentive_programs p where p.superseded_at is null and p.last_seen_at = c.started_at) as stamped_at_cycle
from incentive_discovery_cycles c order by c.started_at desc limit 12
